risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (415.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and negative macro score (-6) create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 43 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 415.2, FOMC today, rising DXY, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), zero fundamental conviction, price below all intermediate MAs, negative CMF/MACD, and no triggered strategies create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
